title: The Abu Dhabi Swap: Prisoner Deal Stalls Peace Talks
description: Russia and Ukraine agree to a major prisoner exchange in Abu Dhabi, but territorial disputes and trust deficits stall broader peace efforts. We break down the deal, the diplomatic routes, and what comes next.

seo.title: Prisoner Deal Agreed, But Why Are Peace Talks Stalled?
seo.description: Russia and Ukraine just agreed to a historic prisoner exchange in Abu Dhabi, yet the broader peace process remains completely stalled while battlefield strikes continue to tear at power grids and infrastructure. With key envoys heading to Moscow and Dublin, the real question is whether this diplomatic momentum can survive territorial disputes and shifting geopolitical leverage before any lasting ceasefire takes hold.
